name: Staff Selection Commission
about: The Staff Selection Commission recruits staff for Group B and Group C posts in central government ministries and departments. Its major exams include CGL, CHSL, MTS, GD Constable, Stenographer, JE and the Delhi Police and CAPF Sub-Inspector exam.

name: Institute of Banking Personnel Selection
about: The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection conducts common recruitment exams for public sector banks and regional rural banks, including PO, Clerk, Specialist Officer and RRB Officer and Office Assistant posts, and also runs recruitment for other organisations.

name: State Bank of India Careers
about: State Bank of India recruits Probationary Officers, Junior Associates (Clerks), Specialist Cadre Officers and apprentices through its own careers portal.

name: Reserve Bank of India Opportunities
about: The Reserve Bank of India recruits Grade B Officers, Assistants, Office Attendants and specialist and contractual staff, such as medical consultants, through its opportunities portal.

name: National Testing Agency
about: The National Testing Agency conducts national entrance and eligibility tests such as JEE Main, NEET UG, CUET UG and PG, UGC NET and CSIR NET, and also handles some recruitment exams.

name: Central Board of Secondary Education
about: The Central Board of Secondary Education conducts Class 10 and 12 board exams and CTET, and runs recruitment for its own posts such as Superintendent and Junior Assistant.

name: India Post GDS Online
about: India Post, the Department of Posts, recruits Gramin Dak Sevaks, Postal Assistants, Postmen, MTS and other staff across postal circles.

name: Sashastra Seema Bal Recruitment
about: Sashastra Seema Bal is a central armed police force under the Ministry of Home Affairs that guards India's borders with Nepal and Bhutan and recruits constables, head constables and officers.

name: CISF Recruitment
about: The Central Industrial Security Force is a central armed police force that secures airports, metros, ports and public sector units, and recruits constables, head constables, paramedical staff and officers.

name: CRPF Recruitment
about: The Central Reserve Police Force is India's largest central armed police force, recruiting constables, technical and tradesmen staff, paramedical staff and officers.

name: AIIMS Examinations
about: AIIMS New Delhi conducts entrance exams for medical, nursing and paramedical courses and recruits faculty, nursing officers and other staff through aiimsexams.ac.in.

name: Life Insurance Corporation of India Careers
about: Life Insurance Corporation of India recruits Assistant Administrative Officers, Assistant Engineers, Assistants and apprentice development officers.

name: Food Corporation of India
about: The Food Corporation of India recruits managers, junior engineers, stenographers and watchmen across its zones.

name: Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board
about: The Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board recruits teachers (TGT, PGT, PRT), clerks, nurses and other staff for the Government of NCT of Delhi and local bodies.

name: Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission
about: The Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission conducts the UP PCS (Combined State/Upper Subordinate Services) exam, lecturer and assistant professor recruitment, and other state gazetted posts.

name: UP Subordinate Services Selection Commission
about: The Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission recruits Group C staff such as Lekhpal, VDO, Junior Assistant and others, and conducts the UP PET.

name: UP Police Recruitment and Promotion Board
about: The Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board recruits UP Police constables, sub-inspectors, jail warders, firemen and other police posts.

name: UP Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad
about: The Uttar Pradesh Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad (UP Board) conducts High School (Class 10) and Intermediate (Class 12) exams in Uttar Pradesh.

name: UP Exam Regulatory Authority (PNP)
about: The Pariksha Niyamak Pradhikari, Uttar Pradesh, handles UP D.El.Ed admissions and counselling and conducts state teaching related exams.

name: National Health Mission Uttar Pradesh
about: The National Health Mission, Uttar Pradesh, recruits community health officers, staff nurses, ANMs, doctors and other health staff on contract.

name: Allahabad High Court
about: The High Court of Judicature at Allahabad conducts recruitment for court staff such as Review Officers, Assistant Review Officers, stenographers and drivers, and for UP district courts.

name: Bihar Public Service Commission
about: The Bihar Public Service Commission conducts the Bihar Combined Competitive Examination (CCE), Bihar teacher recruitment (TRE) and other state gazetted posts.

name: Bihar Staff Selection Commission
about: The Bihar Staff Selection Commission recruits Group C staff for the Government of Bihar through the Inter Level, Graduate Level and other combined exams.

name: Central Selection Board of Constable Bihar
about: The Central Selection Board of Constable, Bihar, recruits Bihar Police constables, driver constables, jail warders, fireman and prohibition constables.

name: Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission
about: The Bihar Police Subordinate Services Commission recruits Bihar Police Sub-Inspectors, Sergeants, Assistant Superintendents of Jail and similar posts.

name: Bihar Technical Service Commission
about: The Bihar Technical Service Commission recruits technical and health staff for the Government of Bihar, such as Junior Engineers, Staff Nurses, Medical Officers and OT Assistants.

name: Bihar School Examination Board
about: The Bihar School Examination Board conducts Bihar Board Matric (Class 10) and Intermediate (Class 12) exams and the Bihar STET and D.El.Ed entrance.

name: State Health Society Bihar
about: The State Health Society, Bihar, recruits community health officers, ANMs, medical officers, specialists and programme staff for the health department on contract.

name: Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board
about: The Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board conducts state entrance exams and counselling for engineering, polytechnic, medical and other courses, and some recruitment exams.

name: Patna High Court
about: The Patna High Court conducts recruitment for court staff such as Assistants, stenographers and drivers, and for district courts in Bihar.
